replies.author: Ogrey
replies.body:
I like the theme it holds, however, the shape of it isn't the optimal, to say the least. Some blocks really clash negatively together, for instance the nether brick fences with all that stained glass. The plentiful amount of wooden fences will create a major FPS drop for players whose computers aren't as beefy as others.
The contour made by floating sandstone slabs is a bit disturbing, also. It just seems kinda random to me, so it's something rather personal I suppose, nonetheless, a good advice would be improving on that.
The birch wood stairs are placed in a rather sporadic way, being quite irregular and odd. I suggest you work on that.
The size of the map is questionable. I think it has the right size, however, as I mentioned previously, the shape of it doesn't seem to be at its best exponent and you may need to rework some parts of the map in order to achieve something that holds a considerable amount of potential.
I've been dropping hints here and there in this whole paragraph you may deem as feedback, since it's intended to be that way, regarding lack of aesthetical features to the map. I understand, the point of the eerily iridescent middle island cluttered with stained glass might've been meant to stand out in a way you react positively in regards of looks. However, I'd rather choose to work with a consistent block palette. The one you have right now seems pretty consistent, aside from the nether brick fences and stained glass. You could even add certain types of stained clay and leaves (believe me or not, leaves blend in quite well with sand/sandstone. I'd recommend birch or oak, since spruce goes better with quartz and that.)
Anyhow, you're off to a good start. Keep improving and you'll eventually reach the goal.
